CANONICAL_NAME.value: Concurrency Kit 0.7.2 -- lock-free data structures, spinlocks with backoff, hazard pointers (Samy Al Bahra)

value.lineage: A C library of the classic concurrent-memory-model machinery: ck_spinlock (ticket, MCS, CLH, anderson, hclh; with ck_backoff exponential backoff), ck_ring/ck_fifo/ck_stack lock-free structures, ck_hp hazard pointers and ck_epoch safe memory reclamation (2011-). Reference rivals: liblfds, Boost.Lockfree.

value.built_to: let many threads share structures without a global lock, and make contending threads back off instead of hammering a cache line
value.pressure: cache-line contention, memory reordering, reclamation while readers are live
value.success_means: linearizable operations under contention; no lost updates; freed memory never dereferenced

value.pressure: resource contention (cache lines, locks), memory-model weakness, reclamation hazards
value.failure_condition: lost updates, torn reads, use-after-free, or a convoy of spinning threads starving the holder
